mechanism: Both are beta-lactam antibiotics with potential for cross-reactivity in penicillin-allergic patients and additive antimicrobial effects, though cephalosporins have ~1-3% cross-reactivity risk with penicillins.
action: Avoid concurrent use unless there is clinical justification and no history of penicillin allergy; if cephalosporin is necessary in penicillin-allergic patients, use third-generation agents with lower cross-reactivity and consider allergy evaluation first.
